rationale: Base 0dd97d3c. AD-324 and epic #880, PR H step 3. The public list of the ir component in the root contract names report_payload and no longer names report_bytes, because render reads the report as an object. contracts/ir.json declares report_payload next to report_bytes. Two measurement budgets rise: calls_unresolved from 972 to 976 and typing_positions from 58 to 60. The head self-observation shows 8 new unresolved calls and 4 removed calls. The new calls are 6 calls on out.write and out.getvalue (3 in codec_wire, 3 in render.html), one piece.replace and one .encode on the piece loop variable. The removed calls are the old json.dumps(...).replace, payload_text.encode, the .encode on the old canonical text and one .get. The two new typing positions are the JSON value annotations of the private recursion in codec_wire. No rule, component, requires entry or Any permission changes. The digests bind the complete contract tree and baseline of 0dd97d3c to the head of this branch.
